dimensions.label: Anonymous public surface states captured directly from craigslist.org
dimensions.rationale: Round 2026-08-21.craigslist-r1 captured direct frames from craigslist.org through a Steel cloud browser (entry, toronto area, sublets search, listing detail, login, help, 404) at 1915x989. The clone's content regions substitute deterministic synthetic catalog data and local map placeholders; structural regions (header/footer/nav) are the fidelity signal. Verified pages: SSIM full-frame 0.51-0.95, mean 0.79; structural pages (login 0.92, help 0.88, not-found 0.95) are closest.

dimensions.label: Clone routes reachable anonymously, asserted live (200, title, no overflow, no outbound requests)
dimensions.rationale: The anonymous clone surface is asserted by websitebench-offline-clone verify live section per checkpoint (HTTP 200, title, no horizontal overflow, zero outbound requests).

dimensions.label: Stateful journeys exercised by the site test suite (browser + backend semantics)
dimensions.rationale: Each frozen journey has at least one automated test (backend semantic or browser) in clone/tests; the coverage claims are updated when the suite passes.

dimensions.label: Zero outbound runtime requests across checkpoints and journeys
dimensions.rationale: The clone serves only same-origin resources; the live diagnostic asserts zero outbound requests and the asset closure is declared empty (no third-party runtime assets).

dimensions.label: Backend semantic coverage: identity, ownership, validation, persistence, isolation, reset
dimensions.rationale: The backend semantic suite (clone/tests/test_backend_semantics.py) asserts the frozen invariants with actor-isolated tests against the loopback clone.
